notes.title: New Content Update, More Guns, Ironman Mode, Basic Hails
notes.content:
[b]More Guns:[/b]
There are now two new guns that can be acquired in the game for a certain amount of credits and materials:

Laser Shotgun:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28608775/c0a4f6bb3cfda85488ec3bce3fd012ce4b9164da.png[/img]
Laser Rifle:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28608775/d358df0e7d8cc96a1ef3d5be0ddfcef0f7280793.png[/img]

Ammo and Armor can also be acquired through this menu in the same way:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28608775/a6a0b371616b6a542081990f693e062601cd03d4.png[/img]


[b]Ironman Mode:[/b]
There is now an "Ironman" mode. It provides the ultimate challenge in the game. There is also a new achievement related to this.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28608775/4505ccbb1a09423e2aeb15b74f4292f9de743841.png[/img]


[b]Basic Hails:[/b]
These are now available for almost all ships and some planets. They are completely optional and don't have a significant effect on the gameplay:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28608775/3ef02ad6416fdedcf189b773edaf14ef398e130f.png[/img]

[b]New Secret Achievment:[/b]
"The Artifician Labyrinth"

This will probably be the last content update I make to ISCS as I am going to be focusing on my next game which I will post links to in the future.

I will still be around to fix bugs and listen to feedback about ISCS. 

This update will obsolete old saves again. However, this should be the last time.

notes.title: Some new bugfixes are live now - obsoleted previous saves - this should be the last time for a while now
notes.content:
WARNING: Due to some more big changes - this patch obsoleted previous saves again.
___________________________________________________________

- Fixed an issue where using quicksave/quickload with the fullscreen UI open would result in a bad save of that UI

- Fixed an issue where the wrong fonts could be used in the UI after loading from a save

- Fixed an issue where crewmembers could not be assigned unique names after loading from a save

- Fixed some spelling errors

___________________________________________________________

The new build is live now 10:00 PM CST 06/09/2017.

Once again, continue to let me know of any problems you are having. If it is a crash - the best thing you can do is post your Windows crash log for me. If I can't figure it out with that then I'll probably ask for a save file.

notes.title: Another set of bugfixes incoming - will obsolete previous saves again
notes.content:
WARNING: Due to some more big changes - this patch will obsolete previous saves again.
___________________________________________________________

- Fixed an issue where the game would crash when salvaging two entities one after the other.

- Fixed an issue where loading a game would lose track of which grid positions you have visited.

- Put the version number on the main menu screen - in the bottom right

- Added some informational notes to the options menu.

- Increased the amount of time ammo sticks around from killed crewmembers so ships can be boarded for ammo more intuitively.

- Fixed an issue where the key binding to open the captain's menu would sometimes be replaced with the 'p' key instead of the default 'BACKSPACE' key.
___________________________________________________________

I'm going to make this build live at 2:00 AM CST 06/02/2017.

Once again, continue to let me know of any problems you are having. If it is a crash - the best thing you can do is post your Windows crash log for me. If I can't figure it out with that then I'll probably ask for a save file.
